## Cold open

> SCENE (states): Berlin lights up on the map of Germany.
> Berlin | Stadtstaat

[dramatic] [[Berlin]] is the capital of Germany, and at the same time one of its sixteen states: a city-state. It's divided into twelve districts, and almost four million people live there.

[dramatic] If you take the citizenship test in Berlin, three of your thirty-three questions are about the state you live in. They come from a list of just ten. Here are all ten, with the answers.

> SCENE (title): Title card.
> BERLIN

## On the map

{Q328}

> SCENE (question): Question card #328. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] The exam shows a map with four states, numbered. [[Welches Bundesland ist Berlin?]] Which federal state is Berlin?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[4]]. Number four: the small state in the middle of Brandenburg.


{Q327}

> SCENE (question): Question card #327. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] [[Welches Bundesland ist ein Stadtstaat?]] Which federal state is a city-state?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[Berlin]]. There are three city-states: Berlin, Hamburg and Bremen. Each one is a city and a state at the same time.


## Flag and coat of arms

{Q325}

> SCENE (question): Question card #325. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] [[Welche Farben hat die Landesflagge von Berlin?]] What are the colors of the state flag of Berlin?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[weiß-rot]]. White and red, with the Berlin bear.


{Q321}

> SCENE (question): Question card #321. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] The exam shows four coats of arms. [[Welches Wappen gehört zum Bundesland Berlin?]] Which coat of arms belongs to the federal state of Berlin?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[Bild 4]], picture four: a black bear on a white shield.


## How it's run

{Q322}

> SCENE (question): Question card #322. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] [[Welches ist ein Bezirk von Berlin?]] Which of these is a borough of Berlin?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[Pankow]]. The others are elsewhere: [[Altona]] is in [[Hamburg]], [[Prignitz]] is in [[Brandenburg]], and [[Mecklenburgische Seenplatte]] is in [[Mecklenburg-Vorpommern]].


{Q323}

> SCENE (question): Question card #323. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] [[Für wie viele Jahre wird das Landesparlament in Berlin gewählt?]] For how many years is the state parliament in Berlin elected?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[5]]. Five years, like almost every state parliament.


{Q324}

> SCENE (question): Question card #324. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] [[Ab welchem Alter darf man in Berlin bei Kommunalwahlen (Wahl der Bezirksverordnetenversammlung) wählen?]] At what age are you eligible to vote in local elections (election of the District Assembly) in Berlin?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[16]]. Here, you can vote in local elections from sixteen. It differs from state to state. For the Bundestag, it's eighteen everywhere.


{Q329}

> SCENE (question): Question card #329. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.
> @ Regierende Bürgermeisterin oder Regierender Bürgermeister

[dramatic] [[Wie nennt man die Regierungschefin oder den Regierungschef des Stadtstaates Berlin?]] What is the title of the head of government of the city-state of Berlin?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[Regierende Bürgermeisterin oder Regierender Bürgermeister]], the governing mayor. Berlin is a city and a state, so its head of government is a mayor with the powers of a minister-president.


{Q330}

> SCENE (question): Question card #330. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.
> @ Senatorin oder Senator für Außenbeziehungen

[dramatic] And a question with a [[nicht]]. [[Welche Senatorin oder welchen Senator hat Berlin nicht?]] Which senator does Berlin not have?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[Senatorin oder Senator für Außenbeziehungen]], a senator for foreign relations. In a city-state, the ministers are called senators. Finance, justice and the interior: Berlin has all of those. Foreign policy is the federation's job.


{Q326}

> SCENE (question): Question card #326. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] [[Wo können Sie sich in Berlin über politische Themen informieren?]] Where in Berlin can you find information on political issues?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[bei der Landeszentrale für politische Bildung]], the state centre for civic education. Every state has one. It's free, it belongs to no party, and it has material on politics in plain language.


## What to remember for the exam

> SCENE (words): The words appear one by one, then settle into a grid.
> Pankow, weiß-rot, Regierender Bürgermeister

[dramatic] Three answers to hold on to: [[Pankow]]. [[weiß-rot]]. And [[Regierender Bürgermeister]].
